name: zhiliu-recruit-desktop
description: 职流 - AI 求职工作台桌面版
author: 知流

scripts.dev:electron: unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE && npm run build:electron && electron .
scripts.build:next: NEXT_OUTPUT=standalone next build && node scripts/copy-standalone.js && node scripts/create-template-db.js
scripts.build: npm run build:next && npm run build:electron
scripts.package:mac: unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac
scripts.package:win: unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win
scripts.package:all: unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --win
